# Demo Event Brief

This fictional brief is used to verify Ambassador document uploads and downloads.

Audience: 350 student builders.
Event: BuildTogether 2026, November 14, 2026, Ann Arbor, Michigan.
Demo pipeline: 26 fictional sponsor accounts, $25,000 fundraising goal.
Partnership opportunities: mentorship, developer tooling, and event sponsorship.

Ambassador also supports the broader idea of coordinating people and outreach for parties, weddings, recruiting, startup go-to-market work, and political campaigns. This walkthrough implements the hackathon sponsorship use case.
